column2: U.S. Energy Information Administration  |  Short-Term Energy Outlook  - October 2026
EIA completed modeling and analysis for this report on Thursday, October 1, 2026.
The approximate break between historical and forecast values is shown with historical data with no shading; estimates and forecasts are shaded gray.
Regions refer to U.S. Census divisions.
See "Census division" in EIA’s Energy Glossary (http://www.eia.gov/glossary/index.html) for a list of States in each region.
Historical data: Latest data available from U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Economic Analysis; Federal Reserve System, Statistical release G17.
Minor discrepancies with published historical data are due to independent rounding.
Forecasts: EIA Short-Term Integrated Forecasting System. Regional macroeconomic forecasts are based on the S&P Global model of the U.S. Economy.
